entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-01-29
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Add LangVersion for C# 15 #82212
    .NET 11
  • Collection Expression Arguments public API #82210
    .NET 11
  • error in typescript file does not show in error list if the typescript file is not open in the editor. #82208
  • `IAssemblySymbol.MightContainExtensionMethods` produces unstable result for a source assembly #82206
  • Title: Add “Strict Member Mode” to Visual Studio / Roslyn to prevent common beginner mistakes (e.g., text vs Text) #82204
  • Title: Add “Strict Member Mode” to Visual Studio / Roslyn to prevent common beginner mistakes (e.g., text vs Text) #82203
  • roslyn-language-server package needs a readme #82200

Closed

  • `[SetsRequiredMembers]` on constructor causes `csc.exe` crash/build & analyzer failures when `required` properties in base class use `field` keyword #80504
    18.4
  • Cannot implement/override an abstract/virtual implementation of an interface with a nullable generic parameter #82202
  • Keep Obsolete ITypeSymbol extension APIs #82148
    18.5
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-11428.136 #82199

PullRequests

Created

  • Unions: Avoid invalid cast exception in erroneous code #82213
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions
  • Limit the FileSystemWatchers to one per drive root for all SimpleFileChangeWatchers #82211
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode
  • Add specific documentation on Tagging infrastructure. #82209
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Apply globalconfig rules to source-generated files #82207
  • Overview docs #82205
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Add README to roslyn-language-server NuGet package #82201

Merged

  • Fix a crash involving `[SetsRequiredMembers]` and required property using field keyword on a base type #82136
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Un-obsolete extension ITypeSymbol APIs #82192
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Address remaining feedback on "Use command line checksumAlgorithm in generator driver" #81992
    Area-Compilers, Next

Updated

  • Support marking generated public APIs as experimental #82131
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Rename - fix rename from conversion operator type #82179
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Unsafe evolution: check overrides and implementations #82172
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Closed classes 2 #82052
  • Improve elimination of redundant evaluations during pattern matching operation #82142
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Pattern Matching
  • Enable generate type for unresolved types in XML doc comment cref attributes #82194
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Extensions: Merge lookup of classic and new extensions #82165
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Change insertionCreateDraftPR to false #82190
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Change vsBranch from 'main' to 'rel/insiders' #82189
  • Normalize paths in MapSourceRoots task #82149
    Area-Compilers
  • MSBuildWorkspace: Load projects for languages that do not have a known command line parser #82159
    Area-IDE, Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • Fix exception in `ExtractMethod` with `var` pattern in compound pattern #82171
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Fix/76886 await nullable value type #82146
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Make Razor imports lazy and nullable #82197
    Area-IDE
